text:
nora: FYI PR #3420 (API defaults + quickstart) is blocked by two things: docs-preview failing on a runtime metadata call (403) and reviewer asking for clarification about retry semantics + idempotency header behavior. @diego @maya can runtime/SDK confirm?

diego: Link to PR?

nora: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3420 -- JS quickstart sets `client.defaultRetries = 2` and also shows an example that omits `x-idempotency-key`. Reviewer says we should state what server does for duplicate requests and what SDK does on retries. Also preview logs show `error: access denied to runtime metadata` in build.

ci-bot: docs-preview job #588 failed: error fetching runtime metadata (403). See /builds/3420/logs/588.

maya: Runtime quick note: Server will treat requests without `x-idempotency-key` as non-idempotent; retries are best-effort but the runtime will not deduplicate. If clients need safe retries they must set `x-idempotency-key`. Server-side retry-on-5xx/backoff policies are conservative and do not automatically replay non-idempotent requests.

diego: SDK note: JS SDK will auto-populate an idempotency key for its internal retry logic unless user passes `idempotencyKey`. We added this to reduce accidental duplicate work. Default retries vary by SDK (JS default 2, Python default 1). We should document both SDK defaults and recommend setting `idempotencyKey` for safety.

nora: Good. So docs should: 1) call out server behavior (no dedupe without header), 2) show how to set `idempotencyKey` in the snippet, 3) list SDK default retry counts per language. Also need the preview 403 fixed before merge window tonight.

diego: The preview 403 is due to the preview SA missing `runtime-reader` role again. I'll add the role and re-run. Also we should avoid live runtime calls in previewable snippets (replace with a small stub token for builds).

sam: I'll update the PR with a one-line change: show setting `idempotencyKey` in the snippet and swap live metadata fetch with `const meta = { name: "PREVIEW" } // preview stub`.

ci-bot: retriggered docs-preview #588 (attempt 2).

ci-bot: docs-preview #588 succeeded.

nora: Thanks. @diego can you +1 on the runtime wording in the PR thread? We want explicit sentence: "The runtime does not deduplicate requests unless an explicit x-idempotency-key is provided; SDKs may auto-generate a key for retries."

diego: +1 for that wording. Runtime confirms behavior unchanged.

sam: I've requested reviewer re-approval and scheduled merge during tonight's window.

nora: Approved and merged in the window. Leaving a follow-up to add a short FAQ line about SDK auto-generated idempotency keys. :white_check_mark:
